mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO video_favorite (id, user_id, video_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{videoId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM video_favorite vf INNER JOIN video v ON vf.video_id = v.id WHERE vf.user_id = #{userId} AND v.status = 'ACTIVE' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT
FROM video v LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = v.author_id INNER JOIN video_favorite vf ON vf.video_id = v.id WHERE vf.user_id = #{userId} AND v.status = 'ACTIVE' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY vf.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
